cases.purpose: Establish pipe readiness before invoking zero-timeout key-read, with no concurrent producer and no controlling terminal.
cases.oracle: Original ASCII decoding and TIMEOUT output contracts, with independent poll(0) readiness evidence and owned-pipe identity. This headless control does not establish PTY mode, cursor or signal requirements.
cases.comparison: Require exact status 0 and raw a newline for a preloaded pipe, or TIMEOUT newline for an empty pipe whose writer remains open. Retain actual child PID/session, input pipe inode/device, readiness and preparation-before-exec timestamps.
